# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: F119 E-Blast Two-Sided Approval

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements that describe screens, states, accessibility, mobile and localisation across the member sign-off screen, the compose/format tool, the dashboard and the screen-standard story (US1, US3, US4, US6) — are they complete, specific and measurable?
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [exploration-2026-09-18.md](../exploration-2026-09-18.md) § C · `docs/ux-standards.md` § 15

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It is reviewer-owned: `[x]` means the reviewer judged the requirements-quality criterion satisfied — it never means implementation is done. `/speckit.implement` reads this state but does not change it.

## Member Sign-off Screen

- [x] CHK001 Is the layout of "formatted version next to the original" specified for phones (stacked order, which comes first) as well as wide screens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-043] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): stacked order on phones not specified
- [x] CHK002 Are the member's three actions (approve, request changes, withdraw) given required confirmation behaviour and wording rules, given that approval is consequential and withdrawal is destructive? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-015] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): confirmation requirements for approve / request changes / withdraw not specified
- [x] CHK003 Is the "reason required" rule for requesting changes given a minimum/maximum length and an error message requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §US2-AS1] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): reason length bounds and error message not specified
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what the member sees after acting (success state, next step, how to get back to the E-Blast list)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §US1-AS4] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): post-action success state / return path not specified
- [x] CHK005 Is the history view (FR-032) specified as a component the member can navigate with a keyboard and a screen reader (ordering, headings per round)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): history view keyboard / screen-reader structure not specified

## Compose & Format Tool

- [x] CHK006 Are toolbar requirements specific about keyboard operation (arrow keys, Home/End, focus return) and about the visible focus state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048]
- [x] CHK007 Is the required behaviour of the toolbar at 320 px stated (wrap vs. overflow menu), given the audit flagged it as undecidable from code? - [x] CHK008 Are the image-insertion dialog's accessibility requirements defined (label for the description field, error announcement when empty, focus return)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): image-insertion dialog a11y not specified beyond FR-051
- [x] CHK009 Is the preview dialog's behaviour specified for screen readers (dialog role, title, what is announced) and for closing (Escape, focus back to the trigger)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043]
- [x] CHK010 Is the empty preview state's content specified (message text, icon or not) so it cannot regress to a blank box? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043, §US3-AS6] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): empty preview state wording not specified
- [x] CHK011 Are "loading state matches the real page's shape" requirements specific enough to be checked (which regions the skeleton must reproduce)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK012 Is the two-column compose layout requirement (FR-050) reconciled with the platform's container tiers, and is the exception recorded where the standard says it should be? - [x] CHK013 Are draft-save feedback requirements defined (busy state, "saved" confirmation, last-saved time) beyond the unsaved-changes fix in FR-045? [Gap, Spec §FR-045] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): draft-save feedback (busy, saved, last-saved) not specified

## Dashboard (US4)

- [x] CHK014 Are the new columns (whose turn, time in stage, round, proposed/confirmed time) given display rules for narrow screens — which are hidden, which move to the card view? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): which new columns hide or move to the card view at narrow widths not specified
- [x] CHK015 Is the "stalled" flag defined visually and semantically (not colour alone; announced to assistive technology)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): stalled flag: not-colour-alone and announcement not specified
- [x] CHK016 Are the stage-chip counts required to be announced once when filters change, consistent with the existing single live region on the queue? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, exploration § C "preserve"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): single live region for chip counts not required in the spec
- [x] CHK017 Is the "upcoming sends" view specified as a filter preset on the same list rather than a new page, so FR-028 and FR-030 cannot be read as conflicting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028 vs §FR-030]
- [x] CHK018 Are the stage labels' translations required to fit the chips at SV string length (audit: SV up to +28 %)? [Gap, Spec §Locales] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): SV fit for stage chips not required
